about: Starter projects for the Shell (q277-starters; starter-zip-2026-11-18). Each entry is a shared recipe in this folder, exported from the Shell's Share tab, or a handoff package (.zip) at an absolute URL such as R2. An entry whose file is missing is not shown. Recipes here are public: no NACC, Riverscapes or other local-only data inside them.

starters.title: Barrier removal (Washington)
starters.blurb: Where removing barriers to fish passage would do the most good, by HUC12: connectivity, ecological integrity, high-value areas, feasibility and support. Public layers do the work; links to NACC barriers and Riverscapes are in the model, switched off until you add your own files.
